description: Use when testing for unvalidated redirects and forwards on an authorized engagement. Covers finding redirect parameters (next, returnUrl, redirect_uri, continue), payload bypasses for domain allowlists (double slashes, backslashes, encoded dots, @ tricks, subdomain tricks, parameter pollution), JavaScript and meta refresh redirects, and OAuth redirect_uri abuse leading to authorization code and token theft. Use when login flows, logout links, or error pages redirect to user-controlled URLs, or when phishing impact needs proof.
